visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a high-end hotel room hallway with a wall-mounted television and a gold geometric wall art piece illuminated by warm lighting. A first-person perspective shows a pink suitcase being pulled along a grey tiled pedestrian bridge at JR Tamachi station, with several commuters walking in the distance. A directional sign for 'Pullman Tokyo Tamachi' is briefly shown against a backdrop of modern office buildings. (2) A hand holds a wooden room key card with the 'Pullman' logo in a softly lit corridor. The camera then enters an 'Executive Superior King' room, revealing a long, carpeted entryway with orange leaf patterns. The interior features a massive white bed, a grey corner sofa with decorative red pillows, and a small marble table near a large window overlooking the city skyline. (3) Close-ups showcase hotel amenities including two glass bottles of mineral water, a Nespresso box with colorful capsules, and a machine pouring coffee into a white mug. A small refrigerator is opened to show neatly arranged drinks like oolong tea and juice. The bathroom is split into a private toilet room and a main bathroom area with a white marble sink, a large mirror, and a glass-enclosed bathtub. Three bottles of C.O. Bigelow toiletries are lined up on a shelf. A black box is opened to reveal individual packets of toothbrushes and other toiletries. (4) The video transitions to the hotel lobby, which has a long wooden communal table, designer lighting, and comfortable seating. A gym area with several high-tech treadmills is shown through a window. The final real-world shot shows the hotel entrance with a grey textured wall featuring the 'pullman HOTELS' logo. (5) A graphic screen appears with a large QR code inside a pink frame and text instructions. (6) The final screen is a pink promotional graphic featuring the 'Japanuts' brand logo, social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, and call-to-action buttons at the bottom.
